title: Mary E. Lovely on what's really going on with global supply chains
content_preview: How have US tariffs affected global supply chains? Are trading patterns between countries really changing? What can we learn from the fine print of trade agreements? Are the US and China really decoupling? PIIE Anthony M. Solomon Senior Fellow Mary E. Lovely dives into these questions and more with host Anjali V. Bhatt in this episode, exploring Lovely's recent research on global supply chains and US "reciprocal" trade agreements. They discuss lessons from past rounds of US tariffs, how global supply chains are reorganizing (or not), and more. HOST Anjali V. BhattCommunications Manager and…

cn_title: 全球供应链的真相: 美中贸易关系的变化
cn_summary: 本集节目中, PIIE 安东尼·索罗门高级研究员 Mary E. Lovely 与主持人 Anjali V. Bhatt 一起探讨了全球供应链和美中贸易关系的变化。他们讨论了美中贸易关系的变化,以及全球供应链的未来发展趋势。
impact: 本集节目对中国宏观经济、就业市场和青年失业毕业生的影响分析

title: Solar Has Crossed a Critical Economic Tipping Point
content_preview: For years, the economic case for solar came with an awkward qualification. Yes, it had no fuel bill. Yes, its operating costs were low. And yes, over the life of a project it could already produce cheaper electricity than a new coal or gas plant. But first, someone had to pay for it. Solar concentrated most of its lifetime costs at the beginning. Fossil power appeared to ask for less capital upfront and spread the rest of the bill across decades of coal or gas purchases. In rich countries with deep capital markets, that distinction could be managed.…

cn_title: 太阳能已经跨越了一个关键的经济拐点
cn_summary: 太阳能的经济优势已经不再是过去的担忧,它的成本已经降低到可以与传统能源竞争。太阳能的投资成本已经降低,其生产成本也已经降低,这使得太阳能成为一个可持续的能源来源。
impact: 本集节目对中国能源政策、环境保护和可持续发展的影响分析
